## 改了什么（修的是哪个 Issue 就写 Fixes #编号）/ What changed (write "Fixes #number" for the issue it fixes)



## 怎么验证的（跑了哪些测试、在什么设备上试过）/ How it was verified (tests run, devices tried)



## 检查 / Checklist

- [ ] 构建通过，相关测试通过 / Builds, and the relevant tests pass
- [ ] QML 静态检查 0 个警告 / QML lint reports zero warnings
- [ ] 新的界面文字都有中文译文 / New interface text has its Chinese translation
- [ ] 需要时更新了文档或帮助 / Docs or help updated where needed
